Aws.//: Only Bedrock reaches real AWS in dev (see Cloud:BedrockProvider). These credentials serve that one call; S3, KMS and IAM go to the local simulator and never touch this profile.
Aws.//CredentialSource: Same mechanism as Test and Production. The .NET simulator implements the real AWS4-X509 CreateSession contract, so the gateway signs and parses identically here; only RolesAnywhere:EndpointOverride differs. Set this to 'LocalProfile' instead if you want to run without the simulator.

RolesAnywhere.//: ARNs are the ones IamLocal seeds. dev-role has a complete trust policy; read-only-role deliberately omits sts:TagSession and sts:SetSourceIdentity so the most common production 403 can be reproduced on demand.
RolesAnywhere.//EndpointOverride: The only difference from Test and Production. Refused by StartupValidator outside Development.

Certificate.//: Issue one with: curl -X POST 'http://localhost:5003/rolesanywhere/generate-test-cert?subject=CN=unified-gateway-dev'. Keep certs/ out of source control.

Aws.//AssumeRoleArn: Empty in dev: the profile's own identity is used directly. Test and Prod assume a role instead, which is why UseLocalProfile is refused there.
Aws.//LocalProfileName: A profile in ~/.aws/credentials or ~/.aws/config. It needs bedrock:InvokeModel in the region above, and model access granted in the Bedrock console.

LocalProviders.//TimeoutSeconds: Local generation is linear in max tokens. Measured ~5.4 tok/s for a 27B model on a workstation, so a 2048-token budget needs ~380s. Size this to the largest MaxTokens an application here may request. Note the real control is the application's MaxTokens: a 6-minute synchronous request is a poor interactive experience whatever the timeout says.

Cloud.//: DEV runs the control plane against DOTNET_AWS_SIMULATOR (S3Local 5001 / KmsLocal 5002 / IamLocal 5003). Flip Provider to 'Aws' and drop the LocalDotNet block to use real AWS.
Cloud.//BedrockProvider: Bedrock alone leaves the simulator. No local stand-in produces real model output, and that output is the thing under development. Test and Prod omit this key entirely, so Bedrock inherits Provider:'Aws' there and this dev-only override disappears with the file.
Cloud.//BedrockServiceUrl: Must stay empty while BedrockProvider is 'Aws' so the SDK resolves the real regional endpoint. Startup refuses any other combination.

AccessControl.//: IamLocal auto-creates any role that is assumed, with Allow */*, so evaluation runs end to end but effectively grants everything in dev.

Storage.//: DEV: S3Local in the .NET simulator. Created on demand.

Billing.//DefaultCosts: Applied when an application has no rate card, or a request carries no application. Such charges are flagged as estimated.
